about_the_game:
⚔ Fast-Paced and Fluid Combat

Face relentless waves of Void monsters with agile movement and precise aiming. Master timing and direction to clear enemies in style! Experience the tension and rhythm of a top-down bullet hell shooter with satisfying feedback.

🎮 Enjoy the game with your choice of control scheme:

keyboard and mouse, mouse-only, or game controller.

🌟 Diverse Characters × Customizable Skills

Unlock over 20 unique Followers, each with their own skills and control feel. Easy to pick up, yet deep to master—combine skills and modules to build your own combat style. Every run is a brand new challenge!

🌲 Strategic Skill Trees × Randomized Builds

Level up, branch out, and reinforce your build the way you want. Plan your upgrades carefully and select the best skill combinations from randomized choices to increase your chance of survival.

🧭 Map Exploration and Treasure Hunting

Dive into labyrinthine dungeons, uncover rare treasures and hidden events as you slowly unravel the mystery of the Realm of Black Mulberry.

🕊 A Tale of Astral Legends and Salvation

The goddess has vanished into a dimensional rift, swallowed by the Realm of Black Mulberry. As an Astral Savior, summon your power and fight against the Void that devours all—restore hope to the world!

  • 20+ unique characters, each with their own main weapon and skill tree

  • 20 distinct Arcana, each with a dedicated skill tree

  • 300+ skills to create your perfect combat build

  • 8 base maps plus 6 high-difficulty variants

  • Over 300 quests to complete

  • 100+ collectible items to discover

  • Original main story and specially designed boss fights

content_descriptors.notes: Some characters wear revealing clothing. No nudity or sexual content. Gameplay is focused on fantasy combat.

short_description: The official sequel to Astral Stairways by Firedog Studio, now making its debut on PC! Fend off endless waves of Void monsters with simple controls and over 20 unique Followers, each offering a distinct playstyle!
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
